text:
Nina Gomez: Kicking off slow-burn tiered rollout for v2.4.0 at 02:00 UTC. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Traffic slices: US(slice-a) 10% -> 30% -> 100% over ~40m, EU(slice-b) 5% -> 15% -> 40% with holds, APAC gated until EU stable. Pin fallback = v2.3.9.

DeployBot: Rollout job created: job_id=rb-5732109999-us, region=us-east-1, slice=slice-a, start=10%, next=30% in 15m. Health gates: p99 < 700ms, err_rate < 1%, gpu_mem < 85%, thermal_warn=false.

Liam Brooks: US warmup green. p99=185ms, err_rate=0.3%, gpu_mem=58%. Hold 10m then advance per plan.

DeployBot: US advanced -> 30%.

Eve Park: EU warm pool low after maintenance, auto-scale +1 node kicked. Warming new node (ETA 4m). Hold EU advance until node_ready.

OpsBot: Reminder: change window ends 04:30 UTC. Any manual rollback must include incident tag and owner.

DeployBot: EU job created: job_id=rb-5732109999-eu, region=eu-central-1, slice=slice-b, start=5%, target=15% over 20m.

DeployBot: EU @5% -> p99=240ms, gpu_mem=72%, err_rate=0.5% (holding 5m watch).

Nina Gomez: Operational rule: if gpu_mem > 88% for >3m OR thermal_warn=true -> immediate pause and either KV flush + worker-restart OR fall back to quantized variant q4_K for that slice. On-call must be paged.

Liam Brooks: APAC prep: will enable device diagnostics and conservative ramp policy. APAC remains pinned to v2.3.9 until EU stable and oncall confirms.

DeployBot: EU gpu_mem trending to 90% (2m). Triggering HOLD and sending page to oncall.

Eve Park: Flushing KV cache on slice-b and restarting model-worker process on the warmed node.

DeployBot: After restart: EU gpu_mem=79%, p99=210ms. HOLD cleared, resuming to 15% with 10m watch.

Kai Tan: Suggestion: before full APAC ramp, run a 1% mini-canary in ap-northeast-1 using q4_K to validate latency and decoding changes.

Nina Gomez: Agreed. If EU shows memory fragmentation again, we'll flip slice-b to q4_K and pin v2.3.9 for APAC until q4_K verification done. Rollback/pin command for quick use: redwoodctl set-pin --region ap-southeast-1 --version v2.3.9 --reason "thermal backstop"

DeployBot: Running APAC mini-canary job: job_id=rb-5732109999-apac-mini, region=ap-northeast-1, start=1%, variant=q4_K. Result: p99=410ms, gpu_mem=48%, err_rate=0.7% -> PASS.

Liam Brooks: APAC good to proceed with conservative ramp: 5% -> 10% -> 25% with 20m holdpoints. Enforced min_reserved_capacity=1.15x to avoid thermal spikes.

OpsBot: Release note stub created: v2.4.0 - slow-burn tiered rollout, thermal backstop metrics, q4_K fallback option, pinning flag usage. Link: https://confluence.company/v2.4.0-release-notes

Eve Park: EU stable at 20m watch: p99=198ms, gpu_mem=76%, err_rate=0.4%.

DeployBot: APAC warmup job started: job_id=rb-5732109999-apac, region=ap-southeast-1, slice=slice-c, start=5%, target=25% over 30m. OOM/thermal auto-drain rules enabled.

Kai Tan: Monitoring device-side temps, no warnings so far. If device fragmentation appears, we invoke plan-B: flip APAC slice to q4_K and then re-evaluate.

DeployBot: APAC @5% -> p99=225ms, gpu_mem=62%, err_rate=0.2%. Advancing to 10% per schedule.

Nina Gomez: Final checklist before marking complete: 1) All regions maintained gates for min hold windows 2) No thermal/warning events unresolved 3) Ops logged release notes and assigned post-release review. If all true, we'll mark rollout COMPLETE and schedule post-release eva.

OpsBot: Post-release review task created: TASK-4921 and assigned to @NinaG.

DeployBot: APAC reached 25% target and passed watch windows. Final status: GLOBAL_ROLLOUT=SUCCESS for v2.4.0.

Nina Gomez: Great work. Closing thread. We'll follow up with a short post-release sync tomorrow 09:00 local. :party_popper:
